name: UTV Ghana
description: United Television (UTV) is Ghana's premier Akan entertainment, movie, drama, and news station broadcasting 24/7 from Ship House, Accra.

name: Joy News
description: JoyNews is Ghana's leading 24-hour independent news, political analysis, investigative reports, and current affairs television network.

name: TV3 Ghana
description: First in news, best in entertainment. TV3 broadcasts high-definition programming, Date Rush, Ghana's Most Beautiful, and News 360.

name: GTV (Ghana Television)
description: GTV is Ghana's national public television broadcaster, bringing state events, national updates, Ghanaian culture, and heritage to the world.

name: Channel One TV (Citi TV)
description: Channel One TV (formerly Citi TV) delivers comprehensive news coverage, Breakfast Daily, Point of View, business, and in-depth documentaries.

name: Adom TV
description: Adom TV is the flagship Akan television channel of Multi TV, broadcasting Badwam, local movies, Akan news, and original Ghanaian series.

name: Joy Prime
description: Real entertainment. Joy Prime broadcasts prime international and African movies, lifestyle shows, reality TV, and children's programming.

name: GTV Sports+
description: Ghana's premier 24-hour sports channel, featuring live Ghana Premier League matches, Black Stars coverage, boxing, and athletics.

name: Metro TV Ghana
description: Metro TV provides top tier political commentary, Good Evening Ghana with Paul Adom-Otchere, sports, and international business.

name: Pent TV
description: Pent TV is the global broadcast television ministry of The Church of Pentecost, transforming lives through Christ-centered television.

name: Hope Channel Ghana
description: Hope Channel Ghana brings holistic Christian programming, family life guidance, Bible study, health, and inspirational worship.

name: OTV (Ghana)
description: OTV broadcasts urban Ghanaian music, youth culture, interviews, Afrobeats, and high-energy entertainment.

name: MOGPA TV
description: Moments of Glory Prayer Army (MOGPA) TV broadcasts 24/7 Christian revival, powerful prayers, testimonies, and apostolic ministry.

name: Angel TV
description: Angel TV offers vibrant Akan programming, social advocacy, cultural discussions, gospel shows, and breaking news.

name: DL TV (Mallam / Accra)
description: DL TV broadcasts live family, inspirational, and spiritual programming from Accra and the Mallam broadcast enclave.
